snippet.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Overview Trailer | Capcom Spotlight | 3.5.2026
snippet.description:
The latest trailer for Capcom's all new swordplay action game, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, as shown in Capcom Spotlight on March 5, 2026!

As the 2026 release draws ever closer, take another look at the game's early Edo-period Kyoto setting, and the intense swordplay action that awaits!

Coming to PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam in 2026!

Official Site: https://www.capcom-games.com/onimusha/ws/
Official Social Media Account: https://x.com/OnimushaGame

©CAPCOM
- Footage represents a game still in development.
- Some footage was captured with enemy dismemberment death effects disabled.

#Onimusha #WayoftheSword #OnimushaWayoftheSword
